## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename leaves the agent guide's pre-push instruction pointing at the removed `test` target, which should be fixed because the guide says these commands are the only checks a change gets. The new Layout section matches the files at the pull-request head.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check`, updates the README to say `make check`, and adds a trailing HTML comment to the README. It also adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md to `make check` — Running `make test`, as `AGENTS.md:24` still instructs, now fails because this line renames the target to `check`. The guide reads "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." while the Makefile defines only `check:` and `lint:`, and the added `AGENTS.md:15` says "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets." — Contributors and agents following the guide get a make error instead of the pytest run, in a repository the guide says has no CI. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to name `make check`.
